Sign-up: the user row commits before the invitation is accepted, without a transaction. A failure leaves a user whose retry fails with 'user exists'.
Accepting the invitation, then an activity-log insert: a missing audit row is an accepted best-effort tradeoff.
Sign-up: the user commits before its team is created. A failure leaves a team-less user that cannot sign up again.
Team creation, then an activity-log insert (best-effort audit).

Sign-up: the team-member insert (inside Promise.all) may not happen after the user and team committed; the reported predecessor is an activity log, the alternatives list the team insert. The whole sign-up needs one transaction.
Activity log before the soft delete: a log row for an incomplete deletion is low impact.
Account deletion: the user is soft-deleted before the team membership is removed; a failure leaves a deleted user who is still a team member.
Member removal, then an activity-log insert (best-effort audit).
